vb_textbox.text: I agree with the previous respondent, who also agreed with their previous respondent, saying that it is good practice to stick with the taller hatted knomes as they averaged better overall. They also said not to deviate and stick to the tall hats even when the reward diminishes in the middle of the game.However I found that the small hats that appear brighter in colour were giving many +9 scores. I did stick to the tall ones overall, but switched it up and chose the smaller ones when I got 2 or more low rewards in a row.
